en.title: A Love That Can't Be Tagged, or How to Make an Analog Heart Beat
en.premise: In a world where a "like" on your emotions is treated as justice, I deliberately pretend to be emotionless (zero) and drift through life. Then I meet Luna, an eccentric girl trying to repair an antique steam locomotive in a deserted, out‑of‑range ruin. She’s aiming for the "Ice Castle," a physically frozen server stronghold that serves as a graveyard for all data. Forget efficient, streamlined romance—this is the start of a wildly inconvenient, maddeningly un‑taggable youth.

zh.title: 禁止标签的恋爱，或模拟心脏的敲击方式
zh.premise: 在一个“点赞”情感即正义的世界里，我故意装作“无感情（零）”，随意度日。就在这时，我在一座信号盲区的废墟里，遇见了正在修复古董蒸汽机车的怪异少女——Luna。她的目标是“冰之城”，一个被物理冻结的服务器据点，也是所有数据的墓场。别想要高效的恋爱，那都是狗屁；我们即将展开一段极度不便、令人焦急、无法打标签的青春。
